d: NFL Player Bobby Okereke joins the podcast to rank game day outfits of his teammates  decide how many yards Zach can rush for in a game  determine the biggest animal he can tackle  play some games including blind ranking Bob's/Bobby's, and more!

Debating which celebrities should run for president  which celebrity gets the girl in the club  taking a brain rot quiz  guessing the ugliest birth months  seeing if Corinna Kopf makes more than Lionel Messi and other athletes  real or made up soccer teams  blind ranking ice cream flavors, and more!
